reports.title: ODDITY TECH REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AHEAD OF PLAN, RAISES FULL YEAR NET REVENUE AND ADJUSTED EBITDA OUTLOOK

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: ODDITY is raising net revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance for the full year ending December 31, 2026:

· | Net revenue to decrease by approximately 18.5% year-over-year
· | Adjusted EBITDA between $32 million and $34 million

Current FY2026 Outlook | Prior FY2026 Outlook
Net Revenue | -18.5% | -19.0%
Adjusted EBITDA | $32 to $34 million | $30 to $32 million
ODDITY is providing the following guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026:

· | Net revenue to decrease by between 10% and 11% year-over-year
· | Adjusted EBITDA between $4 million and $6 million
